notes: The flat width c of each plate is derived from the section dimensions as 8.2.2(5) and Tables 7.2 to 7.4 draw it; the working names the source of each. The buckling factor k_σ of each plate is your input.
σ_cr,cs is taken as the critical stress of the most slender plate, which is conservative (B.5.2(3)); a numerical value is usually higher. The buckling factor k_σ of each plate is your input.
This is the cross-section resistance of B.6.2. Member buckling (8.3) is outside Annex B and is not checked.
